in_sanskrit.name: नेताजी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who leads or guides as a master or lord.

in_hindi.name: नेताजी
in_hindi.meaning: नेता (leader) + जी (जी: जीवनदाय (master of life) or जी: जीत (victory)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who leads or guides as a master or lord; a great leader or respected individual.

in_tamil.name: நேதாஜீ
in_tamil.meaning: நேதன் (leader) + ஜீ (ஜீவத்தின் வீரம் (army of life) or ஜீ: ஜீவம் (life) + ஜீ: ஜீதம் (victory)
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who leads an army of life or leads to victory and life.

in_telugu.name: నేదేజీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who leads or guides life or leads to victory.

in_marathi.name: Netaji
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Leader, Respected One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Netaji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Netaji is a title given to a respected leader in Hindu culture. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'netaj' meaning leader or chief.

in_bengali.name: Netaji
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Leader, Respected One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Netaji একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Netaji is a title given to a respected leader in Hindu culture. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'netaj' meaning leader or chief.
